items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...what about the other guys, like Gus Metcalf? Did he read? [INTERVIEWEE] He could read what they show him, yeah.

ctx.x: Well, they, not much. They mostly play what they, what they man show. Well, they took that, they got on with Ben, right? They had Jimmy Hoffer, the old man Hoffer. Guess you got some of his people living now, huh? Jimmy Hoffer, great fella. That's, that's my son. How are you? How you doing?

About the olden times again. Yeah, okay. Let's see. Uh, those bands, those brass bands, you say some of the men read in them then, huh? Like Dajon read? Yeah, he was a good reader. Yeah, but what about the other guys, like Gus Metcalf? Did he read?

He could read what they show him, yeah. Short term, he, I don't know, he, I don't know, how he used to do it, but he, he, he, he played just like it's written. Uh huh. Just had a good year, and most all of them.
